task-planning-status-changes.title: Change task plan status
task-planning-status-changes.intro: Review the selected tasks and choose a plan status. Runs and acceptance records are managed in their own workflows.
task-planning-status-changes.preview_inv: The task check could not be verified. Try again.
task-planning-status-changes.incomplete: The selection could not be verified. Refresh or update your selection.
task-planning-status-changes.locked_coun: {{count}} cannot be changed in this batch
task-planning-status-changes.locked_hint: Resolve these tasks in their workflows or remove them from the selection.
task-planning-status-changes.reason.work: This status is managed in the task’s own workflow.
task-planning-status-changes.reason.acti: A linked run is still active. Review the run before changing the plan status.
task-planning-status-changes.reason.revi: A linked run succeeded. Continue from the original review workflow.
task-planning-status-changes.reason.unve: The linked run could not be verified. Check its record before changing the plan status.
task-planning-status-changes.no_changes: All selected tasks already have this status.
task-planning-status-changes.version_exh: A task has reached its version limit. Review it before changing the batch.
task-planning-status-changes.stale: The tasks or their linked runs changed. Refresh and review the selection again.
task-planning-status-changes.recovery_he: Check the original request using its saved operation ID.
task-planning-status-changes.storage_hel: The browser could not keep the recovery record. Check browser storage before trying again.
task-planning-status-changes.refresh_fai: The operation was recorded. Refresh the task list to see the current statuses.
task-planning-status-changes.access_chan: Project access changed. Check your access to continue.
task-planning-status-changes.access_inva: The project access check could not be verified.
